## Relevant configuration and diagnostics

Include only the config entries needed to reproduce the problem. If useful,
include `defi status` and `defi trace` output captured just after it happens.
The README explains how to run the bundled CLI without Homebrew.

## Logs, if available

An excerpt from around the problem can help. In Finder, choose **Go > Go to
Folder** and enter `~/Library/Logs/Defi/Diagnostics/`. Include only relevant
lines from the diagnostic files, along with the approximate time of the
problem and your time zone. If no files exist, submit the report without them.

Logs are optional. Remove private information before posting an excerpt;
do not attach the entire diagnostics folder.
